skill.name: near-api-js
skill.description: Guide for building JavaScript and TypeScript applications with near-api-js v7 for NEAR blockchain accounts, contracts, tokens, keys, RPC calls, meta transactions, and NEP-413 signing.
skill.summary: Build NEAR blockchain integrations with near-api-js v7 examples and reference patterns.
skill.author: internet-court

security_audit.summary: Static findings were reviewed in context and are mostly false positives from Markdown backticks, TypeScript template literals, RPC examples, and placeholder key material. No prompt injection, hidden exfiltration, or executable malware behavior was found. One documentation issue remains: the key guide shows logging a generated secret key.

remediation.suggestion: Remove the Secret Key console.log example. Replace it with secure storage guidance and public-key-only logging.

remediation.issue: Private key and seed phrase examples need stronger warnings
remediation.suggestion: Add warnings near key examples to avoid real secrets in prompts, logs, source control, and browser code.

remediation.issue: Relayer example needs trust boundary guidance
remediation.suggestion: State that relayers must validate receiver, method, amount, nonce lifetime, and signed action scope.

content.value_statement: NEAR developers need reliable examples for accounts, contracts, tokens, and signing. This skill provides focused near-api-js v7 patterns for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
actual_capabilities: Explains Account and JsonRpcProvider setup for NEAR mainnet and testnet.
Shows contract view and call patterns with ABI and without ABI.
Covers NEAR, fungible token, NFT, and storage deposit operations.
Documents KeyPair, signer, seed phrase, access key, and key rotation workflows.
Guides meta transactions, relayer integration, and NEP-413 message signing.
Lists common RPC endpoints, error classes, and transaction action patterns.
limitations: It documents near-api-js v7 patterns and may not cover future API changes.
It does not run transactions, deploy contracts, or validate live chain state.
Examples use placeholders, so users must supply secure credentials and endpoints.
It is not a smart contract security audit or wallet custody guide.

use_cases.title: Create a dApp integration
use_cases.description: Build account, provider, and contract calls for a NEAR web application.

use_cases.title: Add token operations
use_cases.description: Implement NEAR, fungible token, NFT, and storage registration flows.

use_cases.title: Design signing flows
use_cases.description: Plan key management, NEP-413 authentication, and relayer-sponsored transactions.

prompt_templates.title: Start a NEAR connection
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me how to connect a TypeScript app to NEAR testnet with near-api-js v7. Include provider and account setup.

prompt_templates.title: Call a contract method
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me call a NEAR smart contract with near-api-js. Compare a read-only view call with a signed change call.

prompt_templates.title: Implement token transfers
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a near-api-js flow for transferring a fungible token and registering the receiver for storage when needed.

prompt_templates.title: Review advanced signing
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my near-api-js plan for meta transactions, NEP-413 authentication, and key rotation. Identify security and reliability concerns.

output_examples.input: I need to call a payable contract method from a NEAR web app.
output: Provider and account setup plan for the selected network.
Contract call steps with required gas, deposit, and signer notes.
Error handling checks for failed transactions and missing accounts.

output_examples.input: I need a gasless minting flow for users without NEAR.
output: Relayer-side submission plan with expiration handling.
Security notes for relayer trust, nonce lifetime, and action scope.

output_examples.input: I need wallet login with NEP-413.
output: Server verification checklist using account ID, public key, signature, and payload.
Replay protection notes for nonce storage and expiration.

best_practices: Use testnet examples first, then switch endpoints and account names deliberately.
Keep private keys, seed phrases, and signer material out of logs and source control.
Set clear gas, deposit, allowance, and transaction finality requirements for each call.
anti_patterns: Do not paste real private keys or seed phrases into prompts or examples.
Do not use unlimited access key allowances without a documented security reason.
Do not relay signed delegate actions without validating receiver, method, amount, and expiration.

faq.question: What is near-api-js?
faq.answer: near-api-js is a JavaScript and TypeScript library for interacting with NEAR accounts, contracts, transactions, and RPC APIs.

faq.question: Does this skill support Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can this skill send real transactions?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and examples. The user or application controls any actual transaction submission.

faq.question: Does it cover token storage deposits?
faq.answer: Yes. The token guide includes registration and storage deposit patterns for NEP-141 token workflows.

faq.question: Does it explain NEP-413 authentication?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers signing messages, verifying signatures, nonce use, and server-side verification flow.

faq.question: How should users handle private keys?
faq.answer: Users should keep keys out of prompts, logs, source control, and browser code unless a secure wallet flow is used.
